dialogues.speaker: Armin
dialogues.text: Sis, you've got to believe that Aranara are real now!

dialogues.speaker: Arina
dialogues.text: No. The Aranara we saw, was only what the Dendro Archon willed us to see.

dialogues.speaker: Arina
dialogues.text: Sweet dreams are wonderful, but don't confuse them with reality. It's like dreaming about getting a perfect score on an exam. You still need to hit the books after you wake.

dialogues.speaker: Arina
dialogues.text: I only speak the truth, and I'll say it again. The teacher has already said it many times. Aranara do not exist.

dialogues.speaker: Armin
dialogues.text: But... what if... What if there's things even the teacher doesn't know...

dialogues.speaker: Arina
dialogues.text: Well... I'm not saying it's wrong to doubt your teacher, but I'm still not changing my mind about the Aranara.

dialogues.speaker: Arina
dialogues.text: If you want to believe in them, Armin, that's fine! After all, you're still young.
